scope.baseline: current workflow, fresh execution, current hub rules, no lineage or reuse
scope.baselineFollowup: Owner approved T2a baseline execution, but it is a separate task; only Diagnose and Reuse, not Supervision.

authority.rule: Use existing sealed selection and fresh final readers only; this harness produces no attempt/result/winner/adoption decision and writes no study ledger.

trials.order: paired AB/BA by parity of corpus index plus repetition
trials.coldWarm: record cold and warm observations separately; never relabel warm as cold

trials.order: paired AB/BA by parity of corpus index plus repetition
trials.coldWarm: record cold and warm observations separately; never relabel warm as cold

trials.order: six permutations of baseline/shadow/advisory; advisory still unauthorized
trials.coldWarm: record cold and warm observations separately; never relabel warm as cold

design.population: fixed synthetic local fixtures only; no account/model/native calls
design.order: Use corpus order, not directory enumeration. AB for even (caseIndex+repetitionIndex), BA for odd; 12 paired cases x 3 repetitions balances totals. Do not execute an unauthorized arm. Supervision six orders are ABC, ACB, BAC, BCA, CAB, CBA.

versions.source: Preregistration does not seal evolving code. Every T2a/T3 run receipt must bind the exact code snapshot it executed, including bin/ares.js, package identity, harness/adapter/instrumentation and runtime dependencies, alongside this frozen method/input/expected seal.
versions.environment: record exact OS, CPU/hardware, Bun and any container digest in the run admission receipt; mismatches invalidate the paired comparison

design.humanTiming: distinct participants see each incident once; counterbalance incident assignment across arms. No human participants or sessions are authorized by T1/T2a. Automated source-resolution timings are separate, and cannot substitute for human time-to-find.
design.expectedVisibility: Only the input object within *.input.json is candidate-visible. Wrapper id/trial/scenario, corpus index and *.expected.json stay evaluator-only, never copied into candidate outputs.
design.trustLimit: sealed evaluator is a same-user integrity boundary, not hostile same-UID isolation
design.final: final decisive acceptance always fresh; reuse is not an independent seed/sample
design.seedAssignment: Use each frozen Reuse input.workload.seeds in repetition order, unchanged across arms; the two synthetic variants use the two declared triplets.
design.artifactDigestRule: sha256(canonical JSON: recursively sorted object keys, preserved array order, UTF-8, no whitespace); hash artifact.payload only, excluding digestRule and digest metadata

budgets.coldWarm: three seeded paired repetitions per condition for Diagnose/Reuse; cold resets only private fixture state, warm reuse still unauthorized
budgets.overrun: stop the independent trial, retain failed/cancelled/unknown denominators and available costs; no automatic budget increase
budgets.resourceAdmission: existing host admission; one active attempt per study; no concurrency expansion
budgets.caseBudgetUnit: one scheduled case/arm/seed/cold-or-warm condition, no retries beyond the single attempt; totals include all such units

metrics.acceptedOutcomeRate: correct outcomes accepted by existing selection/final machinery divided by full scheduled cases; failed/cancelled/unknown/excluded remain visible; report completed-only sensitivity separately
metrics.diagnoseAccuracy: correct provenance AND correct next action against sealed expected labels divided by full incident presentations; also report each component
metrics.diagnoseTiming: human monotonic time from presentation to submitted provenance/next action; automated source-resolution time is separately named
metrics.provenanceCompleteness: required provenance links present and correct / all required links, with invalid or unreadable links counted missing
metrics.falseReuse: count reused outputs whose sealed expected validity or current semantic inputs disagree; no reuse attempted in T1
metrics.eligibleComputeReduction: paired median CPU-process-seconds reduction across eligible cases with same environment/seeds/budget; GPU/provider clocks separately reported, never summed
metrics.noHitOverhead: nearest-rank p95 of per-case paired CPU overhead on preregistered no-hit cases; zero/unknown fresh denominator yields insufficient evidence
metrics.supervision: helpful, false, missed, duplicate proposals, extra person decisions and accepted outcomes against full truth-labeled tasks; simulated labels do not measure person benefit
metrics.uncertainty: report sample sizes and per-case paired distributions; median interval from fixed seed 101 bootstrap 1000 resamples if samples exist; p95 reports sample size and nearest-rank convention; no broad superiority claim

thresholds.missingEvidence: unmeasurable human timing or missing cost denominators yields insufficient evidence, never pass

costs.instrumentation: process CPU resource usage, monotonic wall timers, explicit storage/transfer byte counters and retention interval; record instrumentation unavailable as unknown. Provider usage only from measured provider receipts, estimates separately. No instrumentation is executed in T1.
costs.aggregation: No scalar total across CPU/device/wall/idle/person clocks or bytes/tokens/currency. Total cost is a vector of measured dimensions; subset categories annotate totals and are never added twice. Missing any required comparison dimension is insufficient evidence.
costs.unknown: unknown is a literal value, never zero or an inferred estimate

reporting.currentDisposition: not measured; no adopt/restrict/defer verdict yet
reporting.independence: each trial independently stoppable; failure does not block unrelated read-only utility
required: separate source/fixture, hosted CI, and native/live evidence labels
reporting.baselineAuthority: T2a receipts link existing study/attempt/closed comparison refs; this preregistration receipt is not a second result authority
